title: Remote Desktop connection history
whyItMatters: The MRU list shows hostnames and IP addresses the user connected to with Remote Desktop. It maps internal systems the account could reach.
source: Microsoft Learn: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/troubleshoot/windows-server/remote/remove-entries-from-remote-desktop-connection-computer (HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Terminal Server Client\Default MRU values)
notes: MRU0 to MRU9 are values in this key; the Servers sibling key holds one subkey per host. Value data is never read; only counts are reported.
